# link: `LinkOutput`

The `data` payload of `openreadout link PATH… --json`, inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `link`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/link.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/link.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema link`.

## Types

### InputReport

How the inputs turned into data sets.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `datasets` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Data sets measured (rows come from these), including those that failed. |
| `ok` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Data sets measured without error. |
| `failed` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Data sets that failed (their rows carry `error`). |
| `skipped_unknown` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Files found by walking a directory that no reader recognises (not in the table). |
| `skipped_format` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Data sets of other formats left out by the format filter. |
| `skipped_sheets` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Sample sheets and layouts found among the inputs (never measured). |
| `grouped_members` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Files that belong to another input's multi-file data set (measured once, with it). |
| `skipped_examples` | array of `string` |  | A few of the skipped paths, with why. |
| `reused` | `integer` (uint64) |  | Data sets whose rows were reused from the journal of an interrupted run. |

### Confidence

How sure a link is.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"low"` | Circumstantial: a shared control name, a short id inside a file name. |
| `"medium"` | Likely: the same sample name or file stem, a start time without a run length. |
| `"high"` | Recorded identifiers agree (barcode, sample id, the conversion's source file, the same acquisition). |

### LinkGroup

Data sets that measured the same sample.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Group number (from 1, in the order of the first member). |
| `confidence` | [`Confidence`](#confidence) | yes | The weakest link that holds the group together (low when the group has a conflict). |
| `sample` | `string` or `null` |  | The sample id the members share, when they do. |
| `members` | array of [`LinkMember`](#linkmember) | yes | Members in input order. |
| `links` | array of [`Link`](#link) | yes | The links, with evidence. |
| `conflicts` | array of `string` |  | Disagreements inside the group (different sample ids). |

### LinkMember

A member of a group.

| `path` | `string` | yes | The data set. |
| `format` | `string` or `null` |  | Format id. |
| `sample_id` | `string` or `null` |  | Recorded sample id. |
| `well` | `string` or `null` |  | Recorded well. |
| `barcode` | `string` or `null` |  | Recorded barcode. |
| `started_at` | `string` or `null` |  | Acquisition start. |

### Link

A link between two data sets.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `a` | `string` | yes | One data set. |
| `b` | `string` | yes | The other. |
| `confidence` | [`Confidence`](#confidence) | yes | The strongest evidence's confidence. |
| `evidence` | array of [`Evidence`](#evidence) | yes | All evidence found. |

### Evidence

One piece of evidence.

| field | type | always present | description |

### SharedIdentifier

An identifier shared by many data sets or naming a control.

| field | type | always present | description |
